hero.title: Precision Meets Comfort: ZEISS SMILE® Eye Surgery at OPTIMAX
sub: A Flap-Free Laser Vision Correction Option Trusted by Surgeons Worldwide

items.v:
Blurred vision from short-sightedness (myopia) can affect every part of your life — from driving at night to enjoying everyday activities. At OPTIMAX Eye Specialist, we understand that choosing to correct your vision is a major decision.
As pioneers in refractive eye surgery in Malaysia, OPTIMAX is proud to offer ZEISS SMILE®: a proven, minimally invasive alternative to LASIK for those seeking long-term freedom from glasses or contact lenses.

ZEISS SMILE® (Small Incision Lenticule Extraction) is a laser eye surgery technique that corrects myopia and mild astigmatism by reshaping the cornea through a single small incision.
Unlike traditional LASIK, ZEISS SMILE® does not require the creation of a corneal flap, reducing trauma to the eye and the risk of dry eye symptoms post-surgery.
*Suitability is determined by a comprehensive eye assessment with our specialists.

yes.heading: Who Can Benefit from ZEISS SMILE®?

items.v: ZEISS SMILE® is ideal for individuals who:

v: Have stable myopia (short-sightedness) or mild astigmatism
Prefer a less invasive, flap-free alternative to LASIK
Are concerned about post-LASIK dry eyes

items.v: Our team will perform detailed diagnostics to determine if ZEISS SMILE® is a suitable option.

no.heading: Who Is Not Suitable for ZEISS SMILE®?

items.v: ZEISS SMILE® may not be suitable if you:

v: Have severe hyperopia or irregular astigmatism
Have been diagnosed with keratoconus or thin corneas
Have uncontrolled medical conditions like diabetes

items.v: Alternative procedures may be recommended. Your consultation will cover all options.

sections.heading: ZEISS SMILE® Procedure Steps

items.title: Preparation
items.text: Numbing drops are applied; no general anesthesia is needed.

items.title: Laser Treatment
items.text: A femtosecond laser creates a lenticule and small incision inside the cornea

items.title: Lenticule Removal
items.text: The lenticule is removed through the incision, changing corneal shape

items.title: Natural Healing
items.text: The small incision heals without stitches

note: The full procedure usually takes under 10 minutes per eye.

sections.heading: Pre & Post ZEISS SMILE® Instruction

groups.label: After Your Procedure:
items: Use prescribed medications and artificial tears
Avoid swimming, dusty environments, or eye rubbing for 1 month

note: Our team will support you through every stage of healing.
